### CANDIDATE DETAIL
#### 1. psoriasis 2  —  Tier 1 — Definitive / Highly Plausible  (fitness 0.725)
**Link type:** shared causal gene (HGNC:16446)

**Proposed mechanism:** CARD14 (HGNC:16446) —INCREASES→ NF-kappaB signaling pathway (REACT:R-HSA-569095); NF-kappaB signaling pathway (REACT:R-HSA-569095) —LEADS_TO→ Abnormal skin development (HP:0000951); NF-kappaB signaling pathway (REACT:R-HSA-569095) —LEADS_TO→ Psoriasis (HP:0002367). Gain-of-function variants in CARD14 lead to aberrant activation of the NF-kappaB signaling pathway, which in turn results in abnormal skin development seen in pityriasis rubra pilaris and the characteristic skin lesions of psoriasis.

**How to falsify it:** Identification of a loss-of-function variant in CARD14 that causes either disease, or complete lack of association between CARD14 variants and both diseases in large cohorts. _(variant: rs114572160)_

**Why it matters:** Targeting the CARD14-mediated NF-kappaB signaling pathway could offer therapeutic strategies for both pityriasis rubra pilaris and psoriasis.
